summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with SHACLPathError and parse_shacl_path, and test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py with valid, invalid, non-node, and graph-unchanged tests. The 40 tests in the new module and test/test_path.py pass under the shared venv. Deviations and gaps: a non-node guard was added because graph.value(None, ...) acts as a wildcard; it carries a type-ignore[unreachable] that could not be checked because mypy is not installed. black, isort, and ruff are also not installed, so formatting and import order were checked by reading only. Nothing was committed and no packages were installed.
